semantics: External distribution and supplementary representations of canonical DIO/ODI works. Relation types preserve the relation actually asserted or semantically justified; distribution does not imply identity.
relation_rule: Use isIdenticalTo only for genuinely identical intellectual/content objects. Use isSupplementedBy, isVariantFormOf, isDocumentedBy, or another supported relation when that is more accurate. Do not normalize all external copies to one generic relation.

representations.evidence: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.21839423 explicitly states that the record contains the identical preprint first published on ResearchGate and lists this DOI under Related works as Is identical to.
